request.style: English, Celtic, female solo voice with warm choir, uilleann pipes, bodhran, fiddle, acoustic guitar, flute, hopeful and uplifting, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Those who are in the flesh cannot please God
But you are not in the flesh, you are in the Spirit
The Spirit of Christ dwells deep within
If He is not in you, you do not belong to Him

[Chorus]
The Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead
Will give life to your mortal bodies
Through His Spirit who dwells in you
The dead become alive, the grave cannot hold

[Verse]
The body is dead because of sin
But the Spirit is life because of righteousness
We have an obligation to walk in a new way
Not to the flesh, but to the Spirit's holy sway

[Chorus]
The Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead
Will give life to your mortal bodies
Through His Spirit who dwells in you
The dead become alive, the grave cannot hold

[Bridge]
If by the Spirit you put to death the deeds
Of the body, you will live
Led by the Spirit of God
You are children of God

[Chorus]
The Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead
Will give life to your mortal bodies
Through His Spirit who dwells in you
The dead become alive, the grave cannot hold

[Outro]
You are led by the Spirit
Children of God forevermore
